mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug_inventory (drug_id, current_stock, min_threshold, version, last_stockin_time, last_stockout_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{drugId}, #{currentStock}, #{minThreshold}, #{version}, #{lastStockinTime}, #{lastStockoutTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE drug_inventory SET current_stock = current_stock + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, last_stockin_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE drug_id = #{drugId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM drug_inventory WHERE current_stock <= min_threshold ORDER BY current_stock ASC

SELECT i.* FROM drug_inventory i INNER JOIN drug d ON i.drug_id = d.id
AND (d.drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.drug_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.generic_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND i.current_stock <= i.min_threshold
ORDER BY i.update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drug_inventory i INNER JOIN drug d ON i.drug_id = d.id
AND (d.drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.drug_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.generic_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
